usamo-qualifiers.description: Current or former high school students who qualified for the USA Mathematical Olympiad (USAMO) through the AMC 10 / 12 and AIME, i.e. roughly the top few hundred competition mathematics students of the United States in a given year.

imo-gold-medalists.description: Current or former high school students who won a gold medal at the International Mathematical Olympiad (IMO), awarded to roughly the top twelfth of the participants, themselves the best six competition mathematics students of each country.
